description: This file defines the Dialog class, which models browser dialog events (like alert, confirm, prompt) in Playwright. It provides methods to access dialog properties such as type, message, default value, and to accept or dismiss dialogs. The class extends ChannelOwner to facilitate communication through channels, and is tied to the Playwright core internals.

classes.name: Dialog
classes.description: Represents a browser dialog (alert, confirm, prompt) within Playwright; allows interaction with dialogs such as accepting or dismissing them.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a Dialog instance from a channel dialog object.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the Page object associated with the dialog, if available.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of dialog ('alert', 'confirm', 'prompt', etc.).

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the message displayed in the dialog.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Asynchronously accepts the dialog, optionally providing prompt text.

ctags.name: Dialog
ctags.pattern: /^export class Dialog extends ChannelOwner<channels.DialogChannel> implements api.Dialog {$/
